title: PingPong: A Benchmark for Role-Playing Language Models with User Emulation and Multi-Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a length penalty and calculating length-normalized scores to counteract the tendency of both human and LLM judges to assign higher scores to longer outputs.

Implementing a multi-model judge ensemble (averaging scores from different models like Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o) to mitigate the inherent bias of individual LLM evaluators favoring their own generated text.
